column1: # best-config.tsv — EMPIRICALLY-BEST per-query forst-rs config for the 8 NexMark priority queries.
# PURPOSE: best-PERFORMANCE reproduction. Per-query config is INTENTIONAL here
# (the user reversed the same-config constraint 2026-06-14). This is DISTINCT
# from the uniform-config research question driven by run-remote-nexmark-v3.sh,
# which deliberately holds ONE config for all queries. Use run-best.sh to apply.
# ★ KV-SEP POLICY (2026-06-15, user directive): prefer KV-sep ON wherever it has
# BETTER performance. q4/q7/q19/q20 already ON; q9 FLIPPED to ON this session
# (the 16g/TM split now fits via the process.size=10240m carve-out — efdc5997a).
# The ONLY queries still encoded KV-sep OFF are where a SAME-PASS A/B MEASURED ON
# to be slower: q11 (ON 215.8 vs OFF 118.8, ON +82%) and q17 (ON 150.7 vs OFF
# 110.7, ON +36%) — both windowed-AGG-drain, where KV-sep adds a value-deref hop
# the agg read path does not benefit from; plus q12 (neutral, ON 40.6 ~ OFF 41.6,
# source-bound). ⚠ OPEN ACTION: those q11/q17 OFF-wins predate the CURRENT
# read-path lever stack (coalesced deref + join stack + R2a). Re-measure KV-sep
# ON for q11/q17 on the current engine tip before trusting the OFF default; if ON
# is now >= OFF, flip them. NOT flipped yet because no ON re-measure exists on the
# current tip (this is an RD/docs task; the runner re-measures on the box).
# SOURCE: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-08-8c32g-3backend-sweep-results.md
#   - "V3 FULL 8-QUERY" (flag-ON: lz4 + KV-sep + trivial-move + S2-pinned)  tip 1cda0e724
#   - "V3 FLAG-OFF"     (ForSt-matching default: KV-sep OFF)                tip 15436bfde
#   These two are a SAME-PASS A/B (serial, same tip-family) => the flag-ON-vs-OFF
#   per-query deltas are REAL, not box noise. See the doc's
#   "RECOMMENDED SELECTIVE KV-SEP PROFILE" (lines ~2735-2745).
#   - q17 best wall 83.7s is from the routing-adaptive (R2a) capture
#     /tmp/v3-q17-forst-rs-ffm-local.out; plain KV-sep-OFF inline was 110.7s.
# KNOB NAMES verified against engine code (crates/forst-rs-engine/src/db.rs):
#   FRS_KV_SEPARATION    1|true|TRUE => ON  (default OFF)            db.rs:15331
#   FRS_KV_MIN_BLOB_SIZE bytes, default 256, floor 22               db.rs:15460
#   FRS_TRIVIAL_MOVE     1|true|TRUE => ON  (default OFF)            db.rs:15417
#   FRS_RS_S2_PINNED     1|true|TRUE => ON  (default OFF)            db.rs:15529
#   FRS_S2_FANOUT_MIN    usize, default usize::MAX=OFF (R1 adaptive) db.rs:15601
#   FRS_SST_COMPRESSION  none|lz4|zstd, engine default lz4          db.rs:299
#   FRS_VLOG_COALESCE_DEREF 1|true|TRUE => ON (default OFF)         db.rs:312
#                        Coalesced batched value-log deref: KV-sep pure-win read
#                        path. Byte-identical output (db.rs:18576). NO-OP when
#                        KV-sep is OFF (no separated values to deref) → harmless
#                        to leave set. Part of the best config for KV-sep queries.
#   FRS_RS_EXECUTOR      inline(default)|routing|routing-adaptive|coordinated|two-regime|routing-async
#                        ForStRsAsyncKeyedStateBackend.java:1319 (Java/flink side)
# COLUMNS (tab-separated):
#   query  KV_SEPARATION  KV_MIN_BLOB_SIZE  TRIVIAL_MOVE  S2_PINNED  S2_FANOUT_MIN  RS_EXECUTOR  SST_COMPRESSION  VLOG_COALESCE_DEREF  expected_wall_s  status  note
#   - "-" = leave unset (engine default).
#   - status: MEASURED       = the encoded config produced expected_wall_s in a captured run.
#             NEEDS-CONFIRM   = best-known config but THIS exact knob combination's wall is
#                               UNMEASURED (the encoded value is the best component-measured
